content:
The Overtime crew revisits the iPhone Duo after prolonged usage. Is it still worth it without a telephoto lens or Face ID? We dig into its multitasking chops, standout FaceTime features, and how it stacks up against the Galaxy Z Fold 8. Plus, we break down Apple’s unprecedented product blitz and rumors of a second-gen MacBook Neo.
